data.subject: Reviewing your 2027 Medicare plan options
data.body:
Hi Dottie,

I recommend Northlake Choice (PPO) for plan year 2027. It is offered in Lorain County for 2027, and its monthly premium fits your preference for a premium of at most $30 per month. The premium is $18 per month in 2027.

On this plan, Eliquis costs $47 for a 30-day supply in 2027, and Jardiance costs $47 for a 30-day supply in 2027. Jardiance requires prior authorization. Atorvastatin costs $0 for a 30-day supply in 2027, and Metformin ER costs $0 for a 30-day supply in 2027. Dr. Karen Brennan, Dr. Steven Sullivan, and North Coast Regional Medical Center are in the plan’s network for 2027.

AEP runs October 15, 2026 to December 7, 2026, and coverage starts Jan 1, 2027. I’d be glad to talk through these details with you.

Warmly,
Ryan Mitchell
